prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Checking Your Cloud Pet Vault", "Verifying saved companion data and past customization options for your account...", "Your existing companions and unlockables will automatically sync."]
1: ["Your Desktop Companion Has Arrived!", "Use double-click on your companion or press Alt+P anytime to summon, hide, or open pet controls.", "Start Playing", "Quick Shortcut: Alt + P"]
2: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Journey", "Choose whether to customize your unique AI pet or pick a classic desktop companion.", "Continue"]
3: ["Wake Up Your Desktop Friend", "Click the bell to wake up your companion and place them directly on your desktop taskbar.", "Wake Up Pet", "Ring Wakeup Bell"]
4: ["Name Your Desktop Companion", "Give your pet a name to print on their official adoption tag.", "Confirm Name", "Enter Pet Name"]
5: ["Verifying screen overlay permissions and multi-monitor setup...", "Desktop Engine: Active & Layer Ready"]
6: ["Sign In to Keep Your Companions Safe", "Logging in links your pets to your secure account so your progress and customizations are never lost.", "Sign In Safely"]
7: ["Select Your Desktop Friend", "Pick any companion below to begin adoption."]
8: ["Right-click pet for actions • Alt+P to summon/hide • Drag to move pet around your screen", "Controls: Right-Click = Menu, Drag = Move, Alt+P = Toggle Visibility"]
9: ["Don't worry—you can adopt additional pets or change your path anytime later in settings."]
